Title: Video Indexer: multiple facial recognition enhancements have been added

Body.Content:
Multiple enhancements have been made to facial recognition in Video Indexer, including: 

  • Advanced custom face management including multiple face models. 
  • Central management of face models.
  • The ability to view, manage, and delete models from the portal and API. 
  • New ability to train faces from images even before indexing the video. 

To learn more, read the blog.
